new_york.annual_date: First Sunday in November (e.g. November 1, 2026 / November 2, 2025)
new_york.finish_location: Tavern on the Green, Central Park West & 67th St, Manhattan
new_york.course_cutoff_time: 13:45 min/mile pace (~6 hours after last wave start, sweep bus ends ~7:30 PM)
course_peculiarities: Three distinct colored start staging routes (Blue, Orange, Green) on Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge: Blue & Orange run on upper deck, Green runs on lower deck.
All routes converge at Fourth Avenue & 92nd Street in Brooklyn (approx Mile 3 / 4.8 km).
Five major bridges: Verrazzano (mi 1-2), Pulaski (mi 13.1), Queensboro (mi 15-16), Willis Ave (mi 20), Madison Ave (mi 21).

boston.annual_date: Third Monday of April (Patriots' Day, e.g. April 20, 2026 / April 21, 2025)
boston.finish_location: Boylston Street near Copley Square, Boston, MA
boston.course_cutoff_time: 6 hours after the last runner crosses the start line (~5:30 PM)
course_peculiarities: Point-to-point course from west to east; prevailing wind (headwind vs tailwind) has massive impact on times.
First 4 miles drop over 200 feet, tempting early over-pacing and eccentric quad damage.
Newton Hills from Mile 16 to 21 (Firehouse Hill, Commonwealth Ave hills, Heartbreak Hill at Mile 20.5).
Iconic final turns: Right on Hereford, Left on Boylston.

chicago.annual_date: Sunday of Columbus Day weekend in October (e.g. October 11, 2026 / October 12, 2025)
chicago.start_location: Grant Park (Columbus Drive & Monroe St), Chicago, IL
chicago.finish_location: Grant Park (Columbus Drive & Roosevelt Rd), Chicago, IL
chicago.course_cutoff_time: 6 hours 30 minutes from crossing the start line (15 min/mile pace)
course_peculiarities: World record course (Kelvin Kiptum 2:00:35, Ruth Chepngetich 2:09:56).
Loop through 29 Chicago neighborhoods (North to Lincoln Park, West to Near West, South to Pilsen & Chinatown).
Tall skyscrapers in downtown Loop (miles 1-3) induce severe GPS drift / multipath reflections.
Pancake flat elevation profile; only notable gradient is the 'Mount Roosevelt' overpass at mile 26 before the finish.

london.annual_date: Third or Fourth Sunday of April (e.g. April 26, 2026 / April 27, 2025)
london.finish_location: The Mall near Buckingham Palace, London
london.course_cutoff_time: 8 hours from the final start crossing
course_peculiarities: Three separate starts (Blue from Blackheath, Red from Greenwich Park, Green from St John's) converge at Woolwich (approx Mile 2.8).
Passes historic Cutty Sark (mile 6), Tower Bridge (mile 12.5), Canary Wharf loop (miles 14-20), Embankment (miles 23-25), Big Ben / Parliament, and finishes at The Mall.

berlin.annual_date: Last Sunday of September (e.g. September 27, 2026 / September 28, 2025)
berlin.start_location: Straße des 17. Juni (Tiergarten / Großer Stern), Berlin
berlin.finish_location: Straße des 17. Juni (passing through Brandenburg Gate), Berlin
berlin.course_cutoff_time: 6 hours 15 minutes from crossing the start line
course_peculiarities: Single flat loop through Berlin (Tiergarten, Mitte, Kreuzberg, Schöneberg, Steglitz, Charlottenburg).
Widely considered the fastest marathon course in history (multiple world records by Kipchoge, Bekele, Gebrselassie).
Iconic finish running through the Brandenburg Gate with 400m sprint to the line.

tokyo.annual_date: First Sunday of March (e.g. March 1, 2026 / March 2, 2025)
tokyo.course_cutoff_time: 7 hours from crossing the start line
course_peculiarities: Starts with a net downhill drop of ~30 meters from Shinjuku through Iidabashi in the first 5 km.
Multiple out-and-back spurs allowing runners to see elite leaders (Asakusa Kaminarimon, Ginza, Shinagawa).
Extremely strict checkpoint cut-off times at each 5km timing gate with sweep buses.
